name: Software Factory Deploy
run-name: Factory deploy ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || github.sha }}
on:
  # deploy.trigger "checks" (default): after these CI workflows succeeded on the default branch.
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Test"]
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dry_run:
        type: boolean
        default: false
permissions: {}
concurrency:
  # Deployments run strictly one after another; only the newest queued run is kept.
  group: ${{ github.repository }}-software-factory-deploy
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  deploy:
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') ||
      (github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_name == github.event.repository.default_branch) ||
      (github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
        github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' && github.event.workflow_run.head_branch == github.event.repository.default_branch)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 75
    # Protection rules and environment secrets of this GitHub environment apply to every deployment.
    environment: production
    permissions:
      contents: read
      deployments: write
      actions: read
    steps:
      - uses: munichdeveloper/software-factory@__SF_FACTORY_COMMIT__
        with:
          mode: deploy
          dry-run: ${{ inputs.dry_run || false }}
          deploy-ssh-key: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_SSH_KEY }}
          deploy-known-hosts: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS }}
          deploy-host: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_HOST || vars.DEPLOY_HOST }}
          deploy-user: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_USER || vars.DEPLOY_USER }}
          deploy-port: ${{ vars.DEPLOY_PORT }}

name: Software Factory
run-name: Factory ${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_run') && 'notify' || inputs.mode || 'manager' }} ${{ inputs.execution_id }}
on:
  push:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [Test]
    types: [completed]
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 */2 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        type: choice
        options: [manager, merge, notify, check-slack, bootstrap, worker]
        default: manager
      execution_id:
        type: string
        default: ''
      issue_number:
        type: string
        default: ''
      dry_run:
        type: boolean
        default: false
permissions: {}
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.repository }}-software-factory-${{ inputs.mode == 'worker' && inputs.execution_id || 'manager' }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  factory:
    if: github.event_name != 'push' || github.ref_name == github.event.repository.default_branch
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 35
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write
      actions: write
    steps:
      - uses: munichdeveloper/software-factory@__SF_FACTORY_COMMIT__
        with:
          mode: ${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_run' || inputs.mode == 'merge') && 'notify' || inputs.mode || 'manager' }}
          execution-id: ${{ inputs.execution_id || '' }}
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.issue_number || '' }}
          dry-run: ${{ inputs.dry_run || false }}
          openai-api-key: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          slack-bot-token: ${{ secrets.SLACK_BOT_TOKEN }}
  merge:
    needs: factory
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && inputs.mode != 'worker' && inputs.mode != 'check-slack' && inputs.mode != 'notify' && inputs.mode != 'bootstrap' && (needs.factory.result == 'success' || (needs.factory.result == 'failure' && (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_run' || inputs.mode == 'merge'))) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
      issues: write
      checks: read
      statuses: read
      actions: write
    steps:
      - uses: munichdeveloper/software-factory@__SF_FACTORY_COMMIT__
        with:
          mode: merge
          dry-run: ${{ inputs.dry_run || false }}
          openai-api-key: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
  merge-notifications:
    needs: merge
    if: always() && needs.merge.result != 'skipped'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
      issues: write
      actions: read
    steps:
      - uses: munichdeveloper/software-factory@__SF_FACTORY_COMMIT__
        with:
          mode: notify
          dry-run: ${{ inputs.dry_run || false }}
          slack-bot-token: ${{ secrets.SLACK_BOT_TOKEN }}

  push:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [Test]
    types: [completed]
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 */2 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        type: choice
        options: [manager, merge, notify, check-slack, bootstrap, worker]
        default: manager
      execution_id:
        type: string
        default: ''
      issue_number:
        type: string
        default: ''
      dry_run:
        type: boolean
        default: false
permissions: {}
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.repository }}-software-factory-${{ inputs.mode == 'worker' && inputs.execution_id || 'manager' }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  factory:
    if: inputs.mode != 'worker' && (github.event_name != 'push' || github.ref_name == github.event.repository.default_branch)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write
      actions: write
    steps:
      - uses: munichdeveloper/software-factory@__SF_FACTORY_COMMIT__
        with:
          mode: ${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_run' || inputs.mode == 'merge') && 'notify' || inputs.mode || 'manager' }}
          dry-run: ${{ inputs.dry_run || false }}
          openai-api-key: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          slack-bot-token: ${{ secrets.SLACK_BOT_TOKEN }}
  coding:
    if: inputs.mode == 'worker' && !inputs.dry_run
    permissions:
      contents: write
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write
      actions: write
    uses: munichdeveloper/software-factory/.github/workflows/coding-worker.yml@__SF_FACTORY_COMMIT__
    with:

      execution-id: ${{ inputs.execution_id }}
      issue-number: ${{ inputs.issue_number }}
    secrets:
      OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
  merge:
    needs: factory
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && inputs.mode != 'worker' && inputs.mode != 'check-slack' && inputs.mode != 'notify' && inputs.mode != 'bootstrap' && (needs.factory.result == 'success' || (needs.factory.result == 'failure' && (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_run' || inputs.mode == 'merge'))) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
      issues: write
      checks: read
      statuses: read
      actions: write
    steps:
      - uses: munichdeveloper/software-factory@__SF_FACTORY_COMMIT__
        with:
          mode: merge
          dry-run: ${{ inputs.dry_run || false }}
          openai-api-key: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}

    needs: merge
    if: always() && needs.merge.result != 'skipped'

    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
      issues: write
      actions: read
    steps:

        with:
          mode: notify
          dry-run: ${{ inputs.dry_run || false }}
          slack-bot-token: ${{ secrets.SLACK_BOT_TOKEN }}
